scope: Operational performance and private lifecycle only; no accuracy acceptance or threshold selection

fixture.format: 16000 Hz mono signed PCM16 little endian
fixture.restriction: Existing licensed lifecycle fixture only; no frozen FSD50K accuracy holdout and no live recording

benchmark.model: Existing bundled RecordedSoundAnalyzer PANNs plus EfficientAT, fixed frontend and policy
benchmark.runtime: Actual native ONNX Runtime; intra-op 1, inter-op 1, sequential
benchmark.input_per_repetition: Identical pinned first ten seconds of the existing fixture; performance only
benchmark.p95_definition: Nearest-rank ceil(0.95*N), the 19th sorted duration for N=20
benchmark.memory: Baseline before model construction; sampled process PSS and used Java heap while model is live, maximum positive deltas; sample cadence and count recorded, not a guaranteed transient-allocation peak
benchmark.append: Time each real AdditionalSoundNight.accept call with an actual 320-sample/20ms admitted PCM frame while inference is blocked; report all maxima, no trimmed outliers
benchmark.result_policy: Write complete benchmark and fence receipt before gate assertions. A failed gate remains failure; no retry, retuning, omitted slow repetition or fake-native replacement without root review.

concurrency_fixture.purpose: Deterministic scheduling fences, distinct from actual bundled inference measurements
concurrency_fixture.behavior: Latch-controlled ModelFactory may return a previously computed real fixture result to expose queued/running cancellation and late-write boundaries; never presented as a new neural inference or accuracy result
required: gap does not bridge partial PCM
finish does not wait for inference
late result cannot mutate deleted/reused identity

authority.settings: Default Off; explicit Save only changes the additionalSoundAnalysis key for future nights
authority.input: Already-admitted PCM only; no new microphone owner or output
authority.storage: Store19 additional_sound_nights/windows and session-delete trigger, separate from base sound_events
authority.portable: Backup format14; settings and derived estimates intentionally excluded, old base payload unchanged
authority.report: Actual read-only Additional sounds route with exact token/rawStart and recreation; no cue, automation or challenge authority

migration_scope: Constructed17→19 removes all18/19 additive objects, preserves raw session/epoch/alarm rows; separate18→19 preserves old records plus the exact interrupted receipt. No broad migration/unit campaign.
